questions.title: How does FlashAttention‑3 achieve higher GPU utilisation compared to FlashAttention‑2?
questions.question_body:
I saw the paper state that Hopper‐specific instruction support gives roughly twice the throughput compared with FlashAttention‑2
but I’m unsure exactly what architectural differences lead to this improvement.
Could someone explain why adding producer–consumer warp‐specialisation
and overlapping matmul jobs underpins most of the observed speedup?

questions.title: Why does Warp Specialisation unlock asynchronous TMA loads in Hopper?
questions.question_body:
The paper discusses splitting warps into producers (doing TMA load)
and consumers (doing GEMMs). Why do producers release registers
so late works better and why can TMA loads proceed asynchronously
in practice instead of hanging waiting on other threads?

questions.title:
What bottleneck prevents softmax being fused completely
with GEMM even when asynchronous execution exists?
questions.question_body:
In many CUDA kernels GEMM finishes before softmax can start
because softmax depends on matmul output.
FlashAttention‑3 nevertheless overlaps the two.
Can anyone clarify which dependencies have been broken
(and why watching barriers win(…) helps overlay GAP‐WIN permitted!

questions.title:
Why does FVFPW GMMA for FP8 demand "k-major"
and what consequences arise if operand layout isn’t respected?
questions.question_body:
The Hopper FC Transpose docs say blit swap|WGMMA wants operands
contiguous along inner dimension ‘K’.
Whitespaces exploited these values?
What happens internally if "mn‑major" tiles were fed instead—why would
the ITC stall or crash?
